text: What if, starting tonight... you could never fall asleep again?
This isn't made up. It happened to a real person... and it gets worse.
This is Nico. He's exhausted. But sleep just won't come.
Seventeen hours awake. His brain works like he's had a drink.
Twenty-four hours. Now it's like he's drunk.
Day two. Microsleeps begin... a few seconds of sleep he doesn't even notice.
Day three. He starts seeing things that aren't there.
The floor moves. Faces start to change.
Day four. He feels like someone is following him.
Until something whispers in his ear...
But here's what really happened.
In 1964, a student named Randy Gardner stayed awake for eleven days.
He started forgetting things. At one point, he thought he was a famous football player.
And there's a real disease where people can't sleep at all. Fatal familial insomnia.
Because while you sleep, your brain cleans itself.
Skip sleep... and the junk builds up in your brain.
Sleep isn't a luxury. It's the strongest medicine you have.
Seven to nine hours. Every night.
So if you're still awake right now, watching this...
how many hours have you been awake?
And did you see the shadow behind Nico? Comment the second.
Send this to the friend who never sleeps.
